zh.title: 賽斯納 210 在美國密西西比州外海墜毀，機上 6 人罹難
zh.summary: 一架賽斯納 210 於 11 月 24 日墜落密西西比州帕斯卡古拉附近海域，機上 6 人均罹難。美國國家運輸安全委員會將主導調查。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）表示，事故發生於當地時間 11 月 24 日下午約 3 時 30 分，地點在密西西比州帕斯卡古拉西南方外海。
美聯社引述救援人員及地方當局報導，潛水員在機體內尋獲機上 6 人，均已罹難。FAA 表示，美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）將主導調查並公布後續消息。

en.title: Six killed when Cessna 210 crashes off Mississippi coast
en.summary: A Cessna 210 crashed near Pascagoula, Mississippi, on November 24, killing all six people aboard. The National Transportation Safety Board will lead the investigation.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration said the aircraft went down southwest of Pascagoula at about 3:30 p.m. local time on November 24.

Divers found the six occupants in the aircraft, the Associated Press reported, citing responders and local authorities. The FAA said the National Transportation Safety Board would lead the investigation and provide updates.

facts.claim: The FAA placed the Cessna 210 crash southwest of Pascagoula at approximately 3:30 p.m. local time on November 24.
The AP reported that all six people aboard died and were found by divers inside the aircraft.
The NTSB is the lead investigating agency.
